[quote=astanir;60322403]The contacted tribes would express their thanks for the equipment provided by the nordiheimians and the tactical help and training provided.

The Hukuwy-Lukywa would inform the Nordiheimian shadow keepers of the correct cultural practises to approach the islander tribes. Upon arrival the Islander tribes of Sukyawa and Fugujki would listen intently to what the Nordiheimians had to say and eventually decide they would cooperate. A plan would begin to formulate to take control of the lower islands from the Armed restoration front...

Nordiheimian intelligence would almost definitely inform them of Qianxun's "pax internationale" currently undergoing humanitarian efforts across Democratic territory.[/quote]

[u][b]Future deliveries:[/b][/u]
With the shipments of the first weapons, equipment and vehicles getting to the Hukuwy-Lukywa, Nordiheims agents and military logistics officers would start to look at what heavyer weapons and vehicles could potentialy be suplied to the Argossian militias after they did their next move and improved their logistics network and infrastructure.
Would they be able to handle heavy vehicles like the Iron Drake 2 tanks, or would lighter armored vehicles like the AFV-5G105 Cassowary and Platypus 1B be bether suited for them?
The logistics officers adviced for the lighter types of armored vehicles as they were less dependant on air superiority and large supply convoys, allowing for bether more agile movement, as such these vehicles, pluss aditional logistics and light vehicles and weapons, would be gathered in the Ostland storages in anticipation of the creation of coridors between the Hukuwy-Lukywa and the eastern groups to be established, and their logistics network to improve.

[b][u]The Lower Islands:[/u][/b]
The Island tribes of Sukyawa and Fugujki would need support if their evolving plans take over of the islands were to be guarantied, as such the Shadow Keepers and agents on the islands would help sett up areas were packages of weapons and equipment for infantry would start being transfered inn with submarines during nights.
They would also start gathering intel on the local forces of the Armed restoration front, such as their numbers, weapons and points of strenght and weaknesses that could be given to the local Argossians for them to use in their planing to increase their chances of success.
They would also inform the Argossians on the two islands that a convoy of weapons, suplies and vehicles would also be prepared for both islands that would be sendt to them the moment they managed to secured a harbour or port for them to deliver their cargo to.

[b][u]Mapping and investigation of Anti-Air abilites:[/u][/b]
The task of finding out the different factions anti-air abilities, especialy in regards to the central Argossian enclave, were still continuing.
Some infiltrators would investigate the airfields and what military aircraft existed there, while others would hone in on any potential SAM sites and radar instalations, tough the size of the operation did mean it was taking some time for the information to be gathered and then reviewed by Nordiheimian inteligence services.

[b][u]"Pax Internationale" and the Qianxun[/u][/b]
While the general mission of gathering information on the Democratic Army of Astanir was still continuing the increasing amount of people from Pax Internationale and Quanxun was starting to catch the atention of the Nordiheimian infiltrators.
As such there would not only be more infiltrators sendt, even elite Shadow Keeper infiltrators, some would be tasked with keeping a closer eye on these people, and what they were generaly doing, and if the Democratic army were geting any material suport from Qianxun.
While the information would not be as accurates as fully desired, as the infiltrators had to be carefull to not be caught since they did not know how good the Qianxun people would be at detecting them, they would be able to find out if vehicles were given or how often shipments and deliveries came inn.
The inteligence branch of Nordiheims military would also start looking into who exactly the Qianxun were and what their goal was, as the information on this nation was rather lacking.

[b]Involvment in Astanir[/b]

[i]Shocked by the erratic upshoot of conflict and division among the Astaniran republic, the Confederacy has decided the most logical step to take is to directly intervene militarily in hope to establish a humanitarian safe zone that civillians will be able to evacuate to. The location of this safe zone has been up to debate, but currently Pantagruel is seeking to establish an occupational force within the archipelago southeast to Astanir.

Pantagruel will NOT be intervening on any side's behalf within this conflict, and wishes to be the staging ground of peaceful diplomatic talks and resolutions. All sides are invited to the Pantagrueli capital of Teremok where diplomatic talks will be held. 

While Pantagruel's actions may seem virtuous and as the paragon of peace, the interests of the state is still at hand. The archipelago of interest is situated in a major concentration of deep-sea resources that the Pantagruel wishes to gain access to, these resources may include Crude Oil, Natural Gas, and Rare Earth Minerals. An occupation of these territories and the future annexation is seen with much ecstasy.[/i]

[pre]As the rays of dawn lit across the Green Giant, military bases littered all over the nation roared to life. Transport aircraft and aerial divisions were readied, while Strike and Aerial Supremacy fighters intensified their daily patrols, some reaching as far as a mere 50KM of the Astaniran coast. The window of oppurtunity only shortened as time passes, and the Confederacy knew this. 

Months before the operation, Pantagrueli spies infiltrated Astanir, their missions remained simple and covert. Over a 2 month period, an almalgamation of maps received by Astaniri locals helped the spies create a rough canvas of what the island Archipelago looked like, and then the most esteemed military strategists estimated where possible SAM launch sites could be. Every single bit of information was crucial to the operation, maps torn apart and rebuilt again to perfectly reflect the Astaniri republic onto their canvas. 

By late morning, all military positions were rallyed accordingly and readied. An airborne Armada lifted into the air, consisting of transport, air supremacy, strike, tanker, and reconnaisance air craft. The spearhead of the attack was the reconnaisance head, which consisted of the most nimble aircraft of the Pantagrueli fleet, making them the paragon of their specialty. If the aircraft detected a potential threat or an enemy encampment, a squadron of 2 air supremacy and a strike fighter were dispatched to the marked zone, where they'd focus on neutralizing the target as quickly as possible before it could prove a threat to the aerial Armada. This created a divide and conquer narrative, where the recon aircraft would cycle information continously to its adversaries.  

Now it was a question on not if Astanir could respond, but how it would respond to such a formidable threat.[/pre]

[spoiler=[b]Investiture[/b]]
Heath Ymisson was a threat to Clifford Prisk's rule. No other person was strong or brave enough to challenge his rule, besides the clergy. Fighting the theocratic element of the Tallislandic Republic is no easy challenge, not when they're embedded this deep into Tallislandic culture.

If push comes to shove, Prisk would simply not win in challenging Ymisson, who already is against much of Prisk's globalist ideals. Ymisson was personally opposed to bailing out the Flousechian heathens, he opposed the removal of Tylerek natives, despised the corporate friends of Prisk. If Clifford truly wanted to bring Tallisland to the glory it deserved, he had to get rid of Ymisson.

Ymisson however, wasn't totally oblivious. Clifford Prisk and Heath Ymisson's relationship had devolved greatly since Prisk's first crowning in 2010, when the two were close friends. Ymisson and his supporters had attempted to keep Lusandrism focused on Tallisland, developing the nation continuously and promoting itself through innovation.

Prisk's followers however wanted more global promotion, he wanted all to practice the tenets of Lusandrism willingly or not. Prisk wants to join with Hydronia and Thyven, Ymisson supports the Elseyr Defensive Union. The distaste between the two could be seen easily, with condemnations and even excommunications of past Holy Cabinet members.

But still, like a 10 year old millennial marriage with a net worth of -40,000, the two continued to publicly declare their unity. When speaking of the Llyndorran Virus' spread in Tallisland, Prisk proclaimed "Unity between I and Patriarch Ymisson has never been higher,' and that they both looked to stop the spread of the virus. Only one of those statements was true.

The Llyndorran Virus, as satanic in nature as it was, benefited large Tallislandic businesses, to the joy of Prisk. He was quick to support them with government-funded online communication services springing up, later sold off to South Elseyr Gründer Industries to make up for lost government funds.

Ymisson however drained Church resources to maintain small businesses and ensure that hospitals and churches were not overwhelmed with demand. Ymisson was to take the blame for all of Prisk's wrongdoings, whereas Prisk managed to gain the favor for all of Ymisson's rights. If not for Heath wanting to keep the nation in one piece, the clergy would've likely rallied under radical Archbishop Wilhere Błoński to overthrow Prisk.

Prisk however had a couple supporters, who were able to infiltrate Błoński's ranks, who in combination with Ymisson's excommunication of the Archbishop, prevented the coup. Błoński however had not outlived his purpose, and so was hunted down in his exile and brought to President Prisk.

Now, he was brought to Osliburne. In a quiet park, late in the evening, closed off to the public due to "underground maintenance." 

Błoński's swept-back brown hair was disturbed by the evening breeze, the chilled sixty-degree weather allowed for him to wear a suit, something to somewhat conceal his identity. Błoński after all couldn't walk around in his religious robes, for the clergy had ousted him.

Prisk on the other hand was driven to the park in a subtle WMW convoy. The license plates were to be reissued the next day, the cars demolished to remove any evidence. Lots of money just to retain some anonymity, but they were expenses Prisk was more than willing to pay for. Or, more realistically, the taxpayers would unknowingly fund.

He walked down the winding path, AWN mercenaries quietly monitoring the President from a distance to arouse minimal suspicion. When Prisk did finally arrive at the bench where Błoński sat, the two shook hands despite being previously enemies. For a moment, Błoński considered voicing his disgust at Prisk's more casual t-shirt and cargo shorts, though he merely smiled at the President.

"Best to skip over the small talk, I reckon." The President began, to which Błoński responded through only a nod. "Your values aren't so different to mine." A half-truth. "We both want power, Clifford." Prisk chuckled disingenuously. "That we do."

Still wanting to get utility out of the now awkward conversation, Prisk continued from where he left off. "I want you to be my Patriarch." The former Archbishop was too stunned to speak for a moment, being cut off before he could even voice protest. "My friends can get rid of Ymisson, he'll be a footnote." Prisk sat down now, as if to appear more appear more friendly to the man who plotted his coup d'etat.

"You know what this country truly needs to reach it's true glory, you have the ferocity to take initiative when the rest of those clergy would rather sit and wait for Ymisson's blessing. You could really change the world." Though his words seemed laced with optimism, in reality it was only Prisk's Creed speaking. A former Archbishop on the seat of Patriarch would be better than no Patriarch, the people would go mad without one.

Błoński was no less greedy. The Lusandric Holy Texts would compel him to refuse this treacherous proposal, though he had already parted ways with his shame. God, if he was real, had already decided Wilhere's sentence. "Tell me when it's done." Were Wilhere's only words before he walked off into the night, leaving the President on the bench.

Twenty hours later, at around 4 AM, Ymisson's holy attendant would find him dead in his bed, killed by a poisonous fugu fish within his seafood. According to the Holy Chef, the fugu was "misplaced," intended initially for another with a less compromised immune system. 

Before Ymisson's nationwide funeral had even begun, Prisk's contacts within the clergy pushed for an immediate election for a new patriarch, voting in Błoński despite his excommunication. Absolved by the Church of his guilt prior to his coronation, Błoński would now be the new head of the Lusandric Faith.

Patriarch Błoński's first act as patriarch was the recognition of the Shamatine, Argosian, and Amaralo Churches of Lusandrism, integrating them into the broader structure of the Elseyran Lusandric Church. 

With their formal integration, the religious capitals in Tel Karmiv, Talkonur, Dandoomba, and Fata'uleka were all integrated into the Republic of Tallisland, becoming jointly administered by their local Archbishops and by the Republican government in Osliburne.

A large victory has been achieved for Prisk, and it is only the beginning of many he has laid out. With the backing of the Patriarch now firmly in hand, all Prism needs to do to win re-election is bank off of his expansion of the Republic, and maybe appease some of the hardliners that oppose his rule for another eight years. 
[/Spoiler]
